issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 10 requests the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken. The solution implementation (solution_repository/aufgabe10.sql) instead selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name (a name column) rather than any ID column. This is a cross-artifact mismatch between the exercise requirement and the provided reference solution and would confuse students about which column to output (name vs. ID) and produce incorrect reference results.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution query to select the Radweg ID column instead of the name. For example, if the Radweg ID column in Radweg_zu_Gemeinde is named radweg_id, change the SELECT to:  SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id  FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde  WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel  AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberfranken' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Unterfranken');  Ensure the query does not apply DISTINCT (since the problem explicitly says duplicates should not be removed). If the actual ID column has a different name (e.g., radwegschluessel or radweg_id), use that column name accordingly.
